name: Canterbury Cathedral
style: Norman architecture; Romanesque architecture; English Gothic architecture; Gothic art
heritage: Grade I listed building; part of UNESCO World Heritage Site
text: Canterbury Cathedral is the cathedral of the archbishop of Canterbury, the spiritual leader of the Church of England and symbolic leader of the worldwide Anglican Communion. Located in Canterbury, Kent, it is on the site of one of the oldest Christian structures in England and forms part of a World Heritage Site. Its formal title is the Cathedral and Metropolitical Church of Christ, Canterbury.
